decision.interpretation: Large bold title-type word 'ORDER' positioned centrally above the descriptive subtitle, introducing the Presidential Order document at this location.
Bold subtitle 'On the promulgation of law1' directly follows the title word 'ORDER', specifying the document's purpose and operating as part of the main title.
Prominent 18pt bold title 'LAW ON CYBER SECURITY2' on page 2 introduces the substantive legal text being promulgated, functioning as the primary document heading.
Centered heading 'Chapter I' marks the beginning of the first major structural division of the law, introducing the subsequent provisions.
Heading 'GENERAL PROVISIONS' immediately follows 'Chapter I', labeling the initial substantive section containing definitions and scope.
Numbered heading 'Article 1. Scope of regulation' introduces the first article's content, defining the law's regulatory boundaries.
